citations.claim: total energy jumped to -137.76 at first violating step 12 vs E0 -206.04
heavy body 3 accelerated to speed ~9.46 during close approach at step 12
heavy body 4 accelerated to speed ~8.61 during close approach at step 12
energy was still near -199.36 at step 11 before the plunge

counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.03254 to 0.01 only, keeping steps=12 and all bodies identical, to resolve the close encounter more accurately

explanation: Two heavy bodies (3: m~19.65, 4: m~14.39) fall toward each other: separation shrinks 1.27 (step10) -> 0.92 (step11) -> 0.45 (step12) while speeds rise to ~9.5 and ~8.6. Substeps per step stay capped at 6, so with dt~0.0325 the leapfrog substepping cannot resolve the rapidly growing softened-gravity acceleration at close range, injecting ~68 energy error (E -137.76 vs E0 -206.04). Reducing dt alone removes the violation, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
vision_note: Two mid-sized bodies on the right approach each other through steps 9 to 11 and become nearly overlapping by step 12 with lengthened motion trails. The other bodies remain widely separated and almost stationary.
